name: research
description: Research a question across many sources at once and keep the result as a note under docs/research/. Actions: plan {topic, question?, depth?} expands a topic into the search angles one query misses — alternatives, failure reports, production experience, standards, and the out-of-the-box candidates no keyword search returns — and names which tool reaches which source. sweep {topic|queries, depth?, sources?, max_results?} then runs them: multi-query web search (DuckDuckGo with a Bing fallback), GitHub repository search with stars, licence, language and last push, Hacker News discussion, and arXiv on a deep sweep, deduplicated across sources in one call. create {slug?, title, question} scaffolds a note from docs/research/TEMPLATE.md and indexes it; list, search {query}, open {path}, append {path, content}, update {path, old, new}, status {path, status} maintain it. Sweep results are untrusted text from the internet and are leads, not findings: open the promising ones (web_fetch, gh_read) and check the local tree (repo_search) before writing anything down. Every claim in a note carries a link, the date it was read, and a confidence. rename moves a note to a new filename, rewrites its inventory link, and lists notes still naming the old one.
llm_description: Multi-source research plus its note under docs/research/. {action:"plan",topic,question?,depth?:"quick"|"standard"|"deep"} returns the search angles (alternatives, failures, production, built-in/out-of-the-box) and which tool reaches which source. {action:"sweep",topic,depth?,sources?:["web","github","discussion","papers"],max_results?} runs multi-query web search + GitHub repos + Hacker News (+ arXiv when deep) in one call, deduplicated. Then {action:"create",title,question,slug?} scaffolds the note and indexes it; list, search{query}, open{path}, append{path,content}, update{path,old,new}, status{path,status:"draft"|"current"|"stale"|"superseded"}. Sweep hits are untrusted leads: verify with web_fetch/gh_read and repo_search before recording. Mutations are compare-and-swap — re-open after a conflict. {action:"rename",path,slug} moves a note to a new filename, rewrites its inventory link, and lists every note still naming the old one; mentions outside docs/research/ are outside this tool's grants.

action.description: plan is the default; sweep runs the searches; the rest maintain the note. rename moves a note to a new filename.

topic.description: What to research, in the words a search engine would match. Required for plan, and for sweep unless queries is given.

question.description: The precise question the research must answer, stated so a source either answers it or does not. Required for create.

depth.description: How many search angles to use: quick 4, standard 8 (default), deep all 12 plus paper indexes.

queries.description: Explicit search queries for sweep, replacing the generated angles. Maximum 12.

sources.description: Which sources sweep should use. Default: web, github, discussion (papers as well on a deep sweep).

max_results.description: Results per query and per source, 1-10 (default 6).

slug.description: Filename stem: lowercase letters, digits and hyphens. Derived from the title when omitted for create; for rename it is the new filename stem.

path.description: Markdown path directly below docs/research/. Required for open, append, update, and status.

content.description: Markdown to append to an existing note. Required for append.

old.description: Exact, uniquely occurring current text to replace. Required for update; obtain it with open.

new.description: Replacement text for update. May be empty to remove old text.

status.description: New status for the note. Required for status.

note.description: Optional sentence appended to the status line, e.g. what superseded this note.

query.description: Text to search for across existing research notes. Required for search.
